content: Ubbaa Haariya Goday tana hara qoncethi bessis; hessika, teera ayfey kumida daacho bessis.
I taako, “Amoxe, neeni ay be7ay?” yaagidi oychis. Taani, “Teera ayfey kumida daacho be7ayis” yaagas. Goday taako, “Ta asaa Isra7eele wursethay gakis; hizape guye taani enta seeronna aggike” yaagis.
Ubbaa Haariya Goday, “He gallas kawo keethan yexiya yethay yeehon laametana; asa ahi dumma dumma bessan wodhana; yeehoy waasoy bayna si77i gidi yegetana” yaagees.
Hinteno, metootanchota un7etheysato, biittan de7iya manqota dhaysanaw koyeysato, haysa si7ite!

Hinte, “Nuuni kathaa bayzanaw ageena xeero ba7aaley awude aadhane! Qassi nuuni nu zal7iya doomanaw Sambaati awude aadhane! Nuuni kathaa guuthaban makidi, daro miishen bayzana. Qassi wordo mizaanen asaa cimmana.
Manquwa biran, metootanchuwa waatha caamman shammana; qassi harqo giste muruuto giste gaten bayzana” yaageeta.
Yayqoobi iya sunthan ceeqetiya Goday, Xoossay, haysada yaagidi ba huuphen caaqis: “Taani enti oothida iita ooso ubbaa dogike.
Hessa gaason biittay yarkees; asa ubbay yeekees. Nayle shaafay kixidi keyeysadanne wodheysada biitta ubbay qaaxananne simmi wodhana” yaagis.
Ubbaa Haariya Goday, “He gallas taani awa seeta gallas wulisana; gallasaa qamisana.

Taani hinte ufaysa baaliya azzanon, hinte yethaa yeehon laammana. Mexi issi na7i hayqin yeekiya asada, hinte hinte huuphiya meedetidi kayo ma7o ma7anada, hintena oothana. He gallasaa wursethay daro camo gidana” yaagees.
Ubbaa Haariya Goday, “Heko, taani biitta ubbaa bolla kosha yeddiya wodey yaana. He koshay kathi woyko haatha kosha gidonashin, si7anaw Godaa qaala dhayo kosha gidana.
Asay dolohape wuloha gakanaw, pudehape dugeha gakanaw woxeretana. Enti Godaa qaala koyanaw yaanne haanne woxana, shin demmokona.
He gallas yegelssa geela7otinne wolqaama panthati saamon piqi gaana.
Samaare eeqatara caaqidaysati, ‘Daana xoossay ero!’ yaageysati, ‘Barsaabe xoossay ero’ yaageysati kundana. Enti zaari dendokona” yaagees.
